author: GoPro
description:
GoPro Athlete @Nikolai_Schirmer is a decorated Norwegian professional freeride skier and filmmaker known for his steep, technical descents and award-winning films. Take a peek inside his HERO13 Black + MAX2 with this POV footage from a full season's worth of sunrise missions, powder chases, and the endless pursuit for the perfect ski run.

Nikolai is a master of finding, climbing, and riding the most remote peaks in Norway, accessed only by foot. He embodies what it means to be a ski mountaineer, and continues to push the limits of what is possible in backcountry skiing. These are the uncut, unedited clips from his 2025/2026 season—kick your feet up and enjoy.
